title: Simulation invariant
statement: Let $A$ be a program with $m$ registers, let $l_0$ be a control label, let an oracle assign Boolean answers to deciders on bit strings, and let $D$ be a Boolean multi-tape Turing machine with an initial state assigned to each decider. For natural numbers $B$ and $W$, a configuration of the compiled machine on input $x$ satisfies the invariant if every work-tape head position lies between $-1$ and $W$, inclusive, and the configuration satisfies the call-validity condition for the program compiled from $A$ starting at $l_0$, with head-position bounds from $-1$ through $W$ and call bound $B$.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definitions of the compiled program or the call-validity predicate, so those parts can only be described by their role.
